designs.title: No.
designs.why: Strong one-ink idea that reads from 3 m: a bored cat lying on a heavy 'NO' and pinning the full stop under its paw, so the joke lives in the drawing. Bold confident linework, a good balance of solid black and white stripes in the letters, and it works on both white and black tees. Production risks: the whiskers are about 4px (~0.8mm at a 12in print) and taper to 1px hairline tips that will break up or drop out on a 156 mesh. A few gaps in the tail hatching are 2-3px (~0.5mm) and will fill in, worst on the black tee where white plus underbase spreads. The bottom half of the canvas is empty, so the art sits high and small on the back.
designs.fix: Set a minimum stroke and gap of about 1mm (5-6px at print size): thicken the whiskers with blunt ends instead of hairline tips, and open or merge the tightest tail hatching gaps. Then scale the art up about 15% to fill the print area.
